project: Taskbar Groups 2.0 — Smart Taskbar Launcher & Windows Workspace Manager

runtime_smoke_test.detail: Published exe started in LocalApplicationData mode; schema created; frmClient and tray initialised; no NullReferenceException after NotifyIcon ContextMenuStrip fix.

features.groups: preserved — width, colors, opacity, open-all, per-group hotkeys, drag-to-reorder
features.shortcuts: preserved — 1-0 hotkeys, Ctrl+Enter open-all, working dir, args, elevation, window state
features.icons: preserved + fixed — serialized SHGetFileInfo/ExtractIconEx (0/400 failures), owned-copy cache, placeholder niemals cached
features.monitors_dpi: fixed — PopupPlacementCalculator + MonitorService; no more SetLocation crash on lower-resolution or secondary monitor
features.folder_shortcuts: fixed — TargetClassifier + legacy migrator store folders as ShortcutType.Folder, never ExtractAssociatedIcon on dirs
features.silent_privilege_escalation: fixed — RunAsAdministrator is explicit, never implicit
features.workspaces: new — WorkspaceService launch-then-place, DPI-aware WindowPlacementCalculator, capture-current-layout
features.diagnostics: new — DiagnosticsService with per-check status + fix suggestion, file logger
features.backup_restore: new — ZIP backup (manifest + db snapshot + JSON export + icons), validate, restore with pre-restore copy, prune
features.updates: new — offline-first UpdateService (no paid API, opt-in feed)
features.migration: new — LegacyMigrator: archival-first, idempotent, per-group failure isolation, unsupported-fields report, byte-identical config/

constraints_honored.no_fake_features: Windows 11 taskbar-pin automation documented as a limitation, not faked
constraints_honored.offline_first: core offline; update feed opt-in; no paid APIs
constraints_honored.license: MIT, original attribution in README and LICENSE
constraints_honored.no_hardcoded_dev_paths: grep at src/, scripts/, installer/ is clean

known_limitations: Windows 11 has no public taskbar-pin automation API; pinning remains one manual click on the generated Shortcuts/*.lnk
Store (ms-appinstaller/AppX) shortcut window placement is best-effort; live-tile processes cannot be enumerated for monitor matching
Portable mode beside-exe layout is kept for 1.x compatibility; new installs default to %LOCALAPPDATA%\\TaskbarGroups

localization.mechanism: src/TaskbarGroups.App/Configuration/Localization.cs with English→tr/en mapping table, AppSettings.Language persisted, tray menu items go through T(), every open form is re-texted on change via Localization.ApplyTo
